items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: We had Buddy Tate on tenor.

ctx.x: Hucko, Mattie Matlock, and Mattie Matlock until his death.

We had Buddy Tate on tenor. The piano -- Buddy Tate needs no introduction, of course, he played many years with Basie. On piano we had Ralph Sutton, Dick Wellstood. Lou Stein, and my hero, Dave McKenna.

Aside from all this, just on the aside, all the piano players mentioned here are my heroes, as I put it, without their superb playing with me, I'm nowhere on the drums. Add to that list Teddy Wilson. He was there last year, too. Playing with Teddy Wilson -- gee, I did some work with his trio, quite a lot of it -- he keeps a drummer on his toes, especially using lots of brushes, because of Teddy's tempos -- they were breakneck. He does it so easy. And it's not that easy on drums to play softly applied sticks at…
